summary.text: Isabella Solis is the Republican candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 37, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Lori Martinez for a seat with no incumbent.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026, in which she was the only candidate on the ballot.
